<!-- Paste this whole file into the PR description on github.com/SukkaW/nolyfill -->

## Summary

This adds a dedicated `@nolyfill/node-domexception` package.

The package that breaks ESM consumers on Node 17+ is [`node-domexception`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/node-domexception) (Jimmy Wärting), whose entire implementation is a single line:

```js
module.exports = globalThis.DOMException
```

It is reached via `@google/genai → google-auth-library → gaxios → node-fetch → fetch-blob`, where `fetch-blob/from.js` does `import DOMException from 'node-domexception'`. nolyfill shipped no replacement for this package, so consumers had no clean `@nolyfill/*` override target for `node-domexception` and were left aliasing it onto unrelated packages.

> Revised from the first version of this PR (which modified `@nolyfill/domexception`) per maintainer feedback — `@nolyfill/domexception` is left untouched, and this introduces `@nolyfill/node-domexception` as its own codegen package matching that package's API shape.

## What this PR does

1. Adds `packages/data/single-file/src/node-domexception.ts` — a typed re-export of `globalThis.DOMException` (native since Node 17.0.0) as the **default export only**, matching `node-domexception`'s bare `module.exports = globalThis.DOMException` shape (no named exports). This mirrors the minimal style of `number-is-nan.ts`.
2. Adds `'node-domexception'` to `singleFilePackagesList` in `create.ts` so future `pnpm codegen` runs keep it in sync with the rest of the project.
3. Runs `pnpm codegen`, which generates `packages/generated/node-domexception/` and registers the package in the root overrides, the CLI `all-packages` list, and the download-stats table.

`@nolyfill/domexception` is not modified by this PR.

## Verification

On Node `v22.22.0`, against the generated package:

```
require('@nolyfill/node-domexception') === globalThis.DOMException   // true
new (require('@nolyfill/node-domexception'))('m','TestError').name   // "TestError"

(await import('@nolyfill/node-domexception')).default === globalThis.DOMException   // true
Object.keys(await import('@nolyfill/node-domexception'))            // ['__esModule','default']
```

Both the CJS `require` and ESM default-import paths return the same native `DOMException` class — matching the original `node-domexception` shape that downstream consumers (notably `fetch-blob/from.js`) rely on.

`pnpm build:tsc` is clean and `pnpm lint` reports no new warnings or errors against the touched file.

## Files

Source (the fix):

* `packages/data/single-file/src/node-domexception.ts`: new source the codegen consumes
* `create.ts`: `+ ['node-domexception'],` inside `singleFilePackagesList`

Generated by `pnpm codegen`:

* `packages/generated/node-domexception/{index.js,index.d.ts,package.json}`: the new package
* `package.json` (root): `node-domexception` added under `overrides` and `pnpm.overrides`, in alphabetical order
* `packages/tools/cli/src/all-packages.ts`: `node-domexception` added to `allPackages`
* `DOWNLOAD_STATS.md`: download-stats row added
* `pnpm-lock.yaml`: regenerated

## Notes

* `engines.node` is left at `>=12.4.0` to match the other generated packages. On Node 12–16, `globalThis.DOMException` is `undefined`; that matches how the upstream `node-domexception` polyfill itself degraded on those versions. Happy to bump the minimum if you'd prefer.
* No tests touched; the package contains no test files. Happy to add a smoke test wherever the project prefers.

comments.body:
Thanks for the review — you're right on both counts. I've reworked the PR:

- `@nolyfill/domexception` is left completely untouched.
- Instead, this now introduces a dedicated `@nolyfill/node-domexception` for the actual upstream package (`node-domexception`, whose entire shape is `module.exports = globalThis.DOMException`).
- It goes through the normal codegen pipeline: a `node-domexception.ts` single-file source (default export only, no named export, matching the upstream API shape) + an entry in `singleFilePackagesList`, then `pnpm codegen` generates everything else. Nothing in `packages/generated/` was hand-edited.

Verified the generated package on Node v22.22.0 — both `require()` and ESM default import return the native `DOMException` class. PR title/description updated to match.
Gentle bump — happy to address any further feedback whenever you have a moment. Thanks again for the initial review.

Friendly bump 🙂 — it's been a couple of months, so checking back on this one. The change you suggested is in: this adds a dedicated `@nolyfill/node-domexception` for the upstream package's API shape, and leaves `@nolyfill/domexception` completely untouched. Happy to rebase onto the latest main or make any further tweaks whenever you have a moment to take another look. Thanks for maintaining nolyfill!

reviews.body: Probably should introduce a `@nolyfill/node-domexception` here for the new API shape.

title: feat(node-domexception): add @nolyfill/node-domexception package
